    matchLabels:
      app: needs-rebase

    metadata:

      containers:

        args:
        - --dry-run=false
        - --github-endpoint=http://ghproxy
        - --github-endpoint=https://api.github.com
        - --github-token-path=/etc/github/oauth
        - --update-period=6h
        ports:
        - name: http

        volumeMounts:
        - name: hmac
          mountPath: /etc/webhook

        - name: oauth

          readOnly: true
        - name: plugins

          readOnly: true
      volumes:
      - name: hmac
